'''Liquid''' is a classification under the [[stocks]] menu, containing nonalcoholic fluids ([[drink]]s are separate) such as [[water]], [[milk]], [[lye]], [[dwarven syrup]], [[honey]] and [[royal jelly]].
Royal jelly which is still part of one of your [[hive]]s is also shown here, while honey will only be shown after it has been [[screw press|pressed]] from a [[honeycomb]].
It also lists [[ichor]], [[blood]] and [[venom]].

[[Magma]] may also be listed as a liquid. This happens whenever the magma fluid melts a non [[magma-safe]] stone. As the raws for any stone list their liquid state as magma, when the magma fluid melts the rocks, they become listed as a magma [[glob]] on the [[stocks]] page.
